title: Research Interests
reading: A bulleted overview of the speaker's research interests across three areas: multimodal generative AI informed by domain-specific knowledge (human, environment, biology), learning under imperfect data and supervision (noisy, imbalanced, long-tailed data), and 2D/3D/4D perception and reconstruction with applications in robotics and AR/VR. Each area is listed with illustrative sub-examples rather than elaborated.

concepts.name: Multimodal generative AI
concepts.why_it_matters: Framed as the speaker's primary research thrust, augmented with domain-specific knowledge.

concepts.name: Learning with imperfect data and supervision
concepts.why_it_matters: Addresses noisy, imbalanced, and long-tailed data common in real-world datasets.

verbatim_spans: Multimodal generative AI with domain-specific knowledge
